notes.title: 01.08.2019 - Build Update!
notes.notes:
Citizens of Gamindustri, we have an update for [i]Megadimension Neptunia VIIR[/i]! Our developers have implemented a patch to the build today which addresses these reported performance issues:

[h1][b]Update Notes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Potential fix has been implemented for possible AVX-related game crashes..
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and help with these issues. If there are other problems, please continue using the forums to search for possible fixes or comment on the thread below to let us know if these issues still occur after the update!

If the issue still persists, please report it to our PC Support Team through our form [url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php][b]here[/b][/url].

Thank you all for your continued patience and support!

notes.title: 01.03.2019 - Update on VIIR Crashes/Bugs
notes.notes:
Hello Citizens of Gamindustri!

We would like to take a moment to let you all know that we are proactively looking into the various crash bugs users are experiencing!

If you are still experiencing issues or have any more information that could help our developers solve these issues, please report your findings and/or specs to our PC Support team [b][url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]here[/url][/b].

We appreciate your patience and support while we work to optimize the game!

notes.title: 10.30.2018 BUILD UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Citizens of Gamindustri, we have a [b]new update[/b] for [b][i]Megadimension Neptunia VIIR[/i][/b]! Our developers have implemented a patch to the build today which addresses these reported performance issues:

[h1][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h1]
 [list]
[*] An issue where the BGM in the game was not looping correctly has been fixed.
[*] Graphic bugs have been fixed and head tracking has been improved in certain VR events.
[*] Compatibility with Dualshock 4 controller has been improved.
[*] Some minor text and audio bugs have been fixed.
[*] Potential fix has been implemented for start up crash affecting some users.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and help with these issues. If there are other problems, please continue using the forums to search for possible fixes or submit the issues to our [b]PC Support Form[/b] [url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php][b]here[/b][/url] to give us feedback directly!
